customer.business: Tirana events app: free discovery and one-tap join for community events (yoga, chess, book clubs, hikes); tickets for big commercial events sold in-app
customer.target: People living in or visiting Tirana who want more social life than the default cafe routine, currently finding events through Instagram stories and WhatsApp groups

behaviours.name: daily Instagram scroller
behaviours.how: finds events only through stories and friends' reposts; never searches, just stumbles

behaviours.name: cafe-default socializer
behaviours.how: same bar, same crew, most evenings; new activities feel like effort and need a friend to come along

behaviours.name: event enthusiast
behaviours.how: already goes to something most weeks, follows venue pages, annoyed at missing things announced late

behaviours.name: free-events-only deal hunter
behaviours.how: joins anything free, hesitates at any ticket over pocket money, pays cash

behaviours.name: community joiner
behaviours.how: in three WhatsApp groups (hiking, language exchange), trusts people over platforms

behaviours.name: cautious newcomer
behaviours.how: wants to meet people but wary of showing up alone to strangers from an app

behaviours.name: early-adopter techie
behaviours.how: downloads every new Albanian app the week it launches, abandons most within a month

objections: Everything is already on Instagram, why do I need another app

weekend day trips when someone organizes

salary arrives at month start, by month end budget is tight

pitch:
A new free app for Tirana: everything happening in the city, in one place, one tap to join.

Small community events — a yoga session by the lake, a chess tournament, a book club, a group hike — are free to join and free to create, always. Anyone can post one.

Big events — concerts, festivals, parties — are also listed, with tickets sold in the app at the organizer's normal price (for example, a concert ticket from around 700 Lek), no extra fee to you.

The feed is complete and curated every week: if it is happening in Tirana, it is here, with real dates, places and a way to see who else is going.

You can rate and review events after you go, so you know what is worth your evening.
